description: Checks a Singapore company's publicly available workplace safety and health status against official bizSAFE, BUS and demerit sources. Use ChatGPT Work for the most reliable results.

defaultPrompt: For the best and most reliable results, switch to ChatGPT Work before starting. Check this <company name>.
interface.longDescription: Verify a Singapore company against current official public sources for bizSAFE Level 3, Level 4 or Star status, MOM's Business Under Surveillance programme, and MOM's list of companies with demerit points. Results include match confidence, source dates and limitations. Use ChatGPT Work for the best and most reliable results because this workflow requires multi-step web research and inspection of official Excel and PDF sources.

name: singapore-wsh-status-checker
